# Vendored pytest-examples

These sources, examples, and tests come from [pydantic/pytest-examples](https://github.com/pydantic/pytest-examples), tag `v0.0.18`, commit `7221ea686b589a3fa471b2aa4170ee7921ac244d`. The original MIT license and README are preserved as `LICENSE` and `UPSTREAM-README.md`.

This development-only dependency is backported to Python 3.8. The root UV configuration selects this copy for Python 3.8, and the temporary bootstrap project installs it with its development tools.
